description: Full website audit in one call: an A-F grade with four 0-100 scores (performance, SEO, security, availability) and every issue listed with a fix. One real browser load gives Core Web Vitals, SEO of the rendered page (title, description, headings, canonical, alt text, Open Graph, JSON-LD) and an optional screenshot; plus uptime, HTTP→HTTPS redirect, TLS expiry, security headers, SPF/DMARC email security, domain registration, robots.txt and sitemap. robots.txt respected; nothing stored. Paid ($0.02, x402).
